title: Alien and Prophet at KFC
description: In a surreal desert landscape under a starry cosmic sky, a grey alien stands beside a robed elderly prophet-like figure. A glowing golden KFC-branded flying car hovers nearby with a large bucket of fried chicken on its roof, in front of a fully lit Kentucky Fried Chicken restaurant building at night.
